title: AppRegistration
description: Declaration an app provides when registering with DF Local Foundation. Incompatible or malformed registrations are rejected — never silently degraded.

app_id.description: Stable lowercase identifier for the app (e.g. 'authorforge'). Must be unique across registered apps.

app_version.description: Semver version of the registering app.

foundation_version_required.description: Minimum DF Local Foundation version this app requires. Registration is rejected if the running foundation version is below this.

schema_namespace.description: PostgreSQL schema namespace owned exclusively by this app. Must not be 'core' or any reserved namespace.

registered_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of when this registration was created.

entitlement_snapshot.description: Optional. Cached Pro/hybrid entitlement state. Non-authoritative — cloud is truth for billing/subscription.

last_validated_at.description: When this snapshot was last validated against the authoritative cloud source.
